title: Functionally dependent facilities.
officialText:
The Board of Standards and Appeals is authorized to issue a variance for the
construction or substantial improvement of a functionally dependent facility provided that:
1. The criteria for Sections G107.2.1 through G107.2.3 are met; and
2. All methods and materials utilized minimize flood damage during the base flood and create no additional threats
to public safety.
